name: Age of Ashes: Dark Nuns
storyline:
In the mysterious legend, the ancient monastery once protected the world and radiated a sacred brilliance. However, a sudden and catastrophic disaster struck. The sun was corroded by dark forces and turned into ashes. At the same time, demons swarmed the world, and the evil forces spread far and wide, plunging all living beings into great suffering.
When darkness enshrouded the land, a nun chosen by fate stepped forward bravely. She bore the sacred mission of purifying the world and banishing the demons. Players will assume the role of this Black Nun and embark on an adventurous journey in a world infested with demons.

Brave adventurers, are you ready to step into this Age of Ashes filled with uncertainties and challenges, take up the mission of exorcism, and write your very own legendary chapter?
summary: Age of Ashes: Dark Nuns immerses you in an apocalyptic world formed from darkness. You can explore haunted dungeons like hospitals, bell towers, altars, churches, and graveyards. The character and scene models in this game are well-detailed and incredibly lifelike to enhance your gaming experience.
